decision: Retained requires a reachable endpoint and satisfaction on every execution of the specified weakened contract. The full reference is adjudicated separately from baseline votes.

methods.BREAK_SHARED_IDENTITY: Key each shared resource by (candidate, resource) instead of resource. Preserve every observed or stipulated status for the fixed candidate. The separate placement diagnostic applies one shared-event mutation to one copy at a time.
methods.COLLAPSE_DELIVERY: Feed command output directly to the delivery slot. Keep separate power, mode, protection, relay, plant and meter requirements. Local Hand already copies the command.
methods.COLLAPSE_PLANT: Replace terminal service magnitude by the service threshold when the actuator reports running (water and hydro) or the drive is powered (tank). Sample that substituted quantity using the original observer guards. Keep original safety, time and upstream enabling conditions. For eligible CHP device/process queries the observed heartbeat serves as the proxy, subject to any explicitly false process prerequisite.
methods.FULL: Retain a reachable candidate meeting the complete bounded service contract; documentary claims require service evidence.
methods.NO_AUTHORITY: Assume the modeled initiating actor present and authorized, and remove water actor wait. Preserve selectors, interlocks, communication and equipment startup times.
methods.NO_OBSERVATION: Project away the final observer stage and its postconditions. Check the actual physical quantity, safety and time.

unit: One supplied candidate in one original operating state.
